entries.title: A revised card marks a picture only when the picture itself changed
entries.body: When a crewmate revised a card, the change bar could not tell one picture from another: a new picture under the same words showed no change, and an old picture beside a reworded caption looked new. The bar now follows the picture file itself. A crewmate that says a picture is replaced now replaces it on the same revision, rather than keeping the old one with a note beside it.
entries.noPicture: The change bar looks the same as before; the fix changes only which revisions it appears beside.

entries.title: A crewmate's heavy run waits when the computer is too busy to check it
entries.body: When the computer was busy, such as while an iPhone simulator started, a crewmate's heavy run could stop at once with "The run's process could not be read; nothing started." The run now waits in line and asks again until the computer can check it.
entries.noPicture: This changes when a crewmate's command waits instead of stopping; no view or control changes.
